Short title and commencement.-(l) This Order may be called the Safety Glass (Quality Control) AmendmentOrder, 2022. (2) It shall come into force on the date of its publicationin the Official Gazette. 2. In the Safety Glass (Quality Control) Order, 2020 in paragraph 1, for sub-paragraph(2), the following sub-paragraphshall be substituted, namely:- "(2) It shall come into force with effect from 151April, 2023.". [F. No. 14031199/2020-CI] ANIL AGRAWAL, Addl, Secy. Note : The principal Order was published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section(ii) vide number S.O. 1045(E), dated the 12th March,2020 and last Order amended vide S.O. 902(E),datedthe 25th February,2021.
